children: said on Tuesday it is planning to stage the maiden flight of its delayed A350F freighter jet in late September, subject to variable factors including the weather.

Industry sources said September 29 has been pencilled in for the flight in Toulouse, France. Reuters reported last month that Airbus was targeting a first flight in September as it tries to better compete with Boeing
